title: The Investable Universe 2.0: Institutional Adoption in Motion
summary: As digital assets have evolved from Bitcoin’s peer-to-peer experiment into a $4 trillion ecosystem spanning Ethereum, stablecoins, tokenized assets, startups, and public investment vehicles, they are redefining value and ownership.
body_markdown:
As digital assets have evolved from Bitcoin’s peer-to-peer experiment into a $4 trillion ecosystem spanning Ethereum, stablecoins, tokenized assets, startups, and public investment vehicles, they are redefining value and ownership while institutions integrate them into core strategies.


**[The full report](https://www.galaxy.com/investable-universe/) *, Institutional Adoption in Motion,* is your roadmap to navigating the fast-moving digital asset industry.
